name: BENCHMARK_INPUT_AND_AUDIT_PLANE_BINDING_GATE
purpose: Fail closed when a committed benchmark result can be aggregate-checked but the exact generated inputs, row-level receiver outputs, intervention transaction, or audit plane are not bound to the executed source path. This gate concerns static execution provenance/replayability, not scientific truth.

required_bindings.requirement: Bind immutable repository/source revision and all material source blobs used by generator, intervention, receiver, evaluator and reducer.
Bind the exact benchmark configuration including all non-default overrides.

Serialize exact generated input records, or bind a deterministic seed, generator implementation/version and deterministic clock/ID policy sufficient to reconstruct exact input bytes. UUID/time/random values used during the run must not be omitted when exact replay is claimed.
Bind the pre-state record IDs/content hashes, the transformation or admission action, post-state record IDs/content hashes, and source-to-derived provenance relations.

For every evaluated query/case, serialize the query identity and ordered returned record IDs/content hashes or an equivalent complete receiver transcript sufficient to re-evaluate success without executing the receiver.

Bind success/verifier semantics, denominator semantics, row-to-trial reducer and trial-to-summary reducer; static recalculation from serialized rows must reproduce reported aggregates within declared formatting precision.

If an audit/hash-chain claim is used as execution evidence, the emitted events must cover the exact executed intervention and receiver path. Events available only on a sibling/newer API do not attest a different historical path.

Bind row/event records to one execution bundle via run_id, trace_id, immutable manifest or equivalent. Missing run identity must be explicit and cannot be silently replaced by repository commit identity.
Any unavailable input/event/row transcript is recorded as missing evidence; absence is not converted to a passing inference.

decision.pass: All required bindings needed by the claimed replay scope are present and the reported result can be recomputed from the package without a richer execution mode, external model/API, hosted runner, paid/monthly quota, or manual user execution.
decision.fail: One or more material bindings are missing, inferred from a different execution path, or require an external executor to reconstruct.

controls.name: positive_static_control
controls.fixture: Fixed member IDs/content hashes, fixed query rows and ordered receiver outputs, exact intervention transaction, bound reducer and run manifest, all stored as immutable text artifacts.

controls.name: missing_generated_input_control
controls.fixture: Configuration and summary are committed, but per-run UUID/time/random inputs and row receiver outputs are not serialized.

controls.name: sibling_audit_api_control
controls.fixture: A newer/sibling API emits hash-chained events, while the historical benchmark executed a different path that emitted no corresponding intervention event.

controls.name: aggregate_only_control
controls.fixture: Per-trial or aggregate metrics exist but exact queries, ordered receiver records and verifier rows are absent.

reference_application.target: sattyamjjain/mnemo Auto-Dreamer-style smoke benchmark committed as auto_dreamer_2026-05-25.{md,json}
passes: per-trial displayed metrics available in Markdown
aggregate arithmetic and 72->1 bank ratio can be statically checked
historical consolidator stores consolidated_from IDs inside the generated memory and relations
fails: needle/input UUIDs generated with Uuid::now_v7 are not serialized
pre/post ordered receiver result IDs/content hashes are not published in the result bundle
historical lifecycle::run_consolidation does not emit a MemoryConsolidated AgentEvent on the checked revision
recall MemoryRead records have no run_id and the event log is not exported with the benchmark
current deterministic query::consolidate audit events belong to a different execution path and cannot retroactively attest the smoke run

phase1_constraints.note: The gate itself is a static artifact audit and can be applied by scheduled Chat using public repository text plus local reasoning/calculation. A target package that fails the gate remains an unresolved child rather than an accepted handoff.
